definitions.explanation: A person one knows but who is not a close friend; someone with whom one has become familiar.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{私|わたし}の{知|し}り{合|あ}いです。
examples.english: He is an acquaintance of mine.

examples.japanese: {知|し}り{合|あ}いを{通|とお}じて{仕事|しごと}を{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I found a job through an acquaintance.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}には{知|し}り{合|あ}いが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: I have many acquaintances in this town.

notes:
FORMATION: From the verb {知|し}り{合|あ}う (to get to know each other), nominalized.

KANJI VARIATION: Can also be written as {知合|しりあい}.

CONTRAST WITH {友達|ともだち}:
・{知|し}り{合|あ}い - someone you know (not necessarily close)
・{友達|ともだち} - friend (implies closeness)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{知|し}り{合|あ}いになる (to become acquainted)
・{知|し}り{合|あ}いを{作|つく}る (to make acquaintances)
・ただの{知|し}り{合|あ}い (just an acquaintance)
